title: 10 Smart Agriculture Research Center Students Graduate, One Achieves Highest GPA in TPB Department at UGM
excerpt: Smart Agriculture Research Center has graduated 10 students who have completed their studies and earned their Bachelor of Agricultural Technology (S.T.P.) degree, with one graduate achieving the highest GPA in the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems (TPB) at UGM and ranking in the top 10 highest GPAs at the Faculty of Agricultural Technology…
body:
Smart Agriculture Research Center has graduated 10 students who have completed their studies and earned their Bachelor of Agricultural Technology (S.T.P.) degree, with one graduate achieving the highest GPA in the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems (TPB) at UGM and ranking in the top 10 highest GPAs at the Faculty of Agricultural Technology UGM. These ten students completed final research projects on various topics, such as irrigation efficiency, artificial intelligence, and nondestructive monitoring of plant conditions and agricultural machinery. The diversity of research topics reflects the Smart Agriculture Research Center's commitment to promoting the development of smart agricultural technology that leverages data and sensors. Below is a summary of the research and achievements of each graduate.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-1-image-21-1030x773.webp)

Rizqi Asy'ari R., S.T.P. completed research titled "Development of an Automatic Sprinkler Irrigation System Based on Hysteresis Method for Water Use Efficiency on Sandy Coastal Land". This research developed an automatic control system capable of regulating irrigation more precisely, making water use on sandy coastal land more efficient. Rizqi was supervised by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. as the First Supervisor and Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. as the Second Supervisor, with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-2-image-20-1030x775.webp)

Ardan Desta Vaunendra, S.T.P. conducted research titled "Design of a Sprinkler Irrigation Control System Based on Fuzzy Logic Algorithm Using Plant Evapotranspiration Data and Soil Moisture on Sandy Coastal Land". The developed system utilizes fuzzy logic to integrate evapotranspiration and soil moisture data so that irrigation operates more adaptively to field conditions. This research was supervised by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. and Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng., and examined by Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-3-image-23-1030x773.webp)

Shidqon Fathul M., S.T.P. completed research titled "Development of a Prediction Model for Total Dissolved Solids and Classification of Pondoh Snake Fruit (_Salacca zalacca_) Maturity Level Nondestructively Based on Machine Learning Using Portable Visible Near Infrared Spectroscopy". This research produced a machine learning model capable of predicting the quality and maturity of pondoh snake fruit without damaging the sample, utilizing portable spectroscopy technology. Shidqon was supervised by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. and Hanim Zuhrotul Amanah, S.T.P., M.P., Ph.D., with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-4-image-22-1030x772.webp)

Devi Ramdani, S.T.P. is one of the top graduates, achieving the highest GPA in the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems (TPB) at UGM and ranking in the top 10 highest GPAs at the Faculty of Agricultural Technology UGM. In addition to this academic achievement, Devi completed research titled "Evaluation of Sprinkler Irrigation Implementation Based on Hydraulic Analysis and Uniformity on Agricultural Land at Glagah Coastal Area, Kulon Progo". This research evaluated the performance of an implemented sprinkler irrigation system through hydraulic analysis to ensure even water distribution on coastal farmland. Devi was supervised by Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. as the First Supervisor and Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. as the Second Supervisor, with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-5-image-19-1030x773.webp)

Muhammad Ilham A., S.T.P. conducted research titled "Analysis and Modeling of Papaya Leaf Health Status (_Carica papaya_ L.) Based on Machine Learning Using Plant Physiological Data". This research built a predictive model to assess the health status of papaya leaves based on plant physiological data, thereby supporting early detection of growth disturbances. Muhammad Ilham was supervised by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. and Dr. Ngadisih, S.T.P., M.Sc., with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-6-image-18-1030x482.webp)

Fajrian Anggit H., S.T.P. completed research titled "Development of a Multisensor-Based Tractor Condition Monitoring System and Edge Processing for Vibration Anomaly Detection". The developed system utilizes various sensors and edge processing to detect vibration anomalies on tractors in real-time, so that potential damage can be identified earlier. Fajrian was supervised by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. and Dr. Radi, S.T.P., M.Eng., with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-7-image-24-1030x581.webp)

Bagus Putra Dwi A., S.T.P. conducted research titled "Development of a Deep Learning-Based Primary Channel Discharge Prediction Model to Support Cropping Pattern Determination in Sapon Irrigation Area, Kulon Progo Regency". The deep learning model developed aims to predict water discharge in the primary channel so that it can serve as a basis for decision-making in determining more appropriate cropping patterns. Bagus was supervised by Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. and Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D., with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-8-image-25-1030x773.webp)

Faiz Ridwan P., S.T.P. completed research titled "Development of a Machine Learning-Based Stomatal Conductance Model for Rice Plants at Various Growth Stages Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Vertical Take-Off and Landing Multispectral". This research utilized multispectral imagery from a VTOL drone to build a prediction model for rice stomatal conductance at various growth stages, as an important indicator of plant physiological conditions. Faiz was supervised by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. and Dr. Ngadisih, S.T.P., M.Sc., with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-9-image-26-1030x775.webp)

Les' Aullian A., S.T.P. completed research titled "Analysis of Electrical Impedance as a Non-Destructive Indicator of Physiological Status of Hydroponic Lettuce (_Lactuca sativa_ L.) Due to Nutrient and Water Stress". This research demonstrated that electrical impedance measurement can be used as a nondestructive indicator to detect the physiological status of hydroponic lettuce plants experiencing nutrient and water stress. Les' Aullian was supervised by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. and Prof. Dr. Mohammad Affan Fajar F., M.Agr., with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-10-image-27-1030x773.webp)

Arinda Fadea P., S.T.P. concluded the graduation series with research titled "Externalization of Tacit Knowledge in Irrigation Gate Operation Decision-Making Based on Quantification of External Factors in Sapon Irrigation Area, Kulon Progo, Yogyakarta". This research sought to document and measure the tacit knowledge of irrigation gate operators so that irrigation operational decision-making can be more standardized and measurable. Arinda was supervised by Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. as the First Supervisor and Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. as the Second Supervisor, with Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. serving as examiner.

The success of these ten students in completing their research is inseparable from the support of various parties. Smart Agriculture Research Center extends sincere gratitude to the Inter-University Excellence Center (PUAPT) UGM for its support in providing research facilities and funding during the research process. Appreciation is also expressed to SINERGI (Integrated Technology Transfer-Based Research Commercialization Scheme), which has facilitated the commercialization of research results to provide broader benefits to the agricultural sector. Support from both programs has been instrumental in promoting the quality of student research while strengthening the ecosystem for smart agricultural technology innovation at the Smart Agriculture Research Center. We hope this synergy will continue and produce more innovations beneficial to the advancement of the agricultural sector in the future. This research also supports the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) through improved agricultural productivity and quality, SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) through more efficient irrigation system innovation, and SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure) through the development of technology based on machine learning, sensors, and automation. Furthermore, this research aligns with SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) through optimizing water and energy resource use, SDG 13 (Climate Action) through more adaptive land and water management, and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals).

original.title: 10 Mahasiswa Smart Agriculture Research Center Lulus, Salah Satunya Raih IPK Tertinggi di Departemen TPB UGM
original.excerpt: Smart Agriculture Research Center kembali meluluskan 10 mahasiswa yang telah menyelesaikan studi dan meraih gelar Sarjana Teknologi Pertanian (S.T.P.), dengan salah satu lulusan meraih IPK tertinggi di Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem (TPB) UGM serta masuk dalam 10 besar IPK tertinggi di Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian…
original.body:
Smart Agriculture Research Center kembali meluluskan 10 mahasiswa yang telah menyelesaikan studi dan meraih gelar Sarjana Teknologi Pertanian (S.T.P.), dengan salah satu lulusan meraih IPK tertinggi di Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem (TPB) UGM serta masuk dalam 10 besar IPK tertinggi di Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian UGM. Sepuluh mahasiswa tersebut menyelesaikan penelitian tugas akhir dengan berbagai topik, seperti efisiensi irigasi, kecerdasan buatan, serta pemantauan kondisi tanaman dan alat mesin pertanian secara nondestruktif. Beragamnya topik penelitian tersebut menunjukkan komitmen Smart Agriculture Research Center dalam mendorong pengembangan teknologi pertanian cerdas yang memanfaatkan data dan sensor. Berikut rangkuman penelitian dan capaian dari masing-masing lulusan.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-1-image-21-1030x773.webp)

Rizqi Asy’ari R., S.T.P. menyelesaikan penelitian berjudul “Pengembangan Sistem Irigasi Sprinkler Otomatis Berbasis Metode _Hysteresis_ untuk Efisiensi Penggunaan Air pada Lahan Pasir Pantai”. Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem kendali otomatis yang mampu mengatur penyiraman secara lebih presisi sehingga penggunaan air di lahan pasir pantai menjadi lebih efisien. Rizqi dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. sebagai Dosen Pembimbing I dan Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. sebagai Dosen Pembimbing II, dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. bertindak sebagai penguji.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-2-image-20-1030x775.webp)

Ardan Desta Vaunendra, S.T.P. mengangkat penelitian berjudul “Rancang Bangun Sistem Kendali Irigasi Sprinkler Berbasis Algoritma _Fuzzy Logic_ Berdasarkan Data Evapotranspirasi Tanaman dan Lengas Tanah pada Lahan Pasir Pantai”. Sistem yang dikembangkan memanfaatkan logika _fuzzy_ untuk mengintegrasikan data evapotranspirasi dan kelembapan tanah agar irigasi berjalan lebih adaptif terhadap kondisi lapangan. Penelitian ini dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. dan Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng., serta diuji oleh Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-3-image-23-1030x773.webp)

Shidqon Fathul M., S.T.P. menuntaskan penelitian berjudul “Pengembangan Model Prediksi Total Padatan Terlarut dan Klasifikasi Tingkat Kematangan Salak Pondoh (_Salacca zalacca_) secara Nondestruktif Berbasis Machine Learning Menggunakan _Portable Visible Near Infrared Spectroscopy_“. Riset ini menghasilkan model machine learning yang mampu memprediksi kualitas dan kematangan buah salak pondoh tanpa merusak sampel, memanfaatkan teknologi spektroskopi portabel. Shidqon dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. dan Hanim Zuhrotul Amanah, S.T.P., M.P., Ph.D., dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai penguji.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-4-image-22-1030x772.webp)

Devi Ramdani, S.T.P. menjadi salah satu lulusan terbaik dengan meraih IPK tertinggi di Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem (TPB) UGM serta masuk dalam 10 besar IPK tertinggi di tingkat Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian UGM. Selain capaian akademiknya, Devi menyelesaikan penelitian berjudul “Evaluasi Penerapan Irigasi Sprinkler Berbasis Analisis Hidraulik dan Keseragaman di Lahan Pertanian Pesisir Pantai Glagah Kulon Progo”. Penelitian ini mengevaluasi kinerja sistem irigasi sprinkler yang telah diterapkan melalui pendekatan analisis hidraulik guna memastikan distribusi air yang merata di lahan pesisir. Devi dibimbing oleh Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. sebagai Dosen Pembimbing I dan Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. sebagai Dosen Pembimbing II, dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai penguji. 

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-5-image-19-1030x773.webp)

Muhammad Ilham A., S.T.P. mengangkat penelitian berjudul “Analisis dan Pemodelan Tingkat Kesehatan Daun Tanaman Pepaya (_Carica papaya_ L.) Berbasis _Machine Learning_ Menggunakan Data Fisiologi Tanaman”. Penelitian ini membangun model prediktif untuk menilai tingkat kesehatan daun pepaya berdasarkan data fisiologis tanaman, sehingga dapat mendukung deteksi dini gangguan pertumbuhan. Muhammad Ilham dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. dan Dr. Ngadisih, S.T.P., M.Sc., dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai penguji.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-6-image-18-1030x482.webp)

Fajrian Anggit H., S.T.P. menyelesaikan penelitian berjudul “Pengembangan Sistem Monitoring Kondisi Traktor Berbasis _Multisensor_ dan _Edge Processing_ untuk Deteksi Anomali Getaran”. Sistem yang dikembangkan memanfaatkan berbagai sensor dan pemrosesan data di sisi perangkat (_edge processing_) untuk mendeteksi anomali getaran pada traktor secara real-time, sehingga potensi kerusakan dapat diketahui lebih awal. Fajrian dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. dan Dr. Radi, S.T.P., M.Eng., dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai penguji.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-7-image-24-1030x581.webp)

Bagus Putra Dwi A., S.T.P. mengangkat penelitian berjudul “Pengembangan Model Prediksi Debit Saluran Primer Berbasis _Deep Learning_ untuk Mendukung Penentuan Pola Tanam di Daerah Irigasi Sapon, Kabupaten Kulon Progo”. Model _deep learning_ yang dikembangkan bertujuan memprediksi debit air pada saluran primer sehingga dapat menjadi dasar pengambilan keputusan dalam penentuan pola tanam yang lebih tepat. Bagus dibimbing oleh Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. dan Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D., dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai penguji.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-8-image-25-1030x773.webp)

Faiz Ridwan P., S.T.P. menuntaskan penelitian berjudul “Pengembangan Model Konduktansi Stomata Tanaman Padi Berbasis Machine Learning pada Berbagai Fase Pertumbuhan Menggunakan _Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Vertical Take-Off and Landing Multispectral_“. Penelitian ini memanfaatkan citra multispektral dari drone VTOL untuk membangun model prediksi konduktansi stomata padi pada berbagai fase pertumbuhan, sebagai indikator penting kondisi fisiologis tanaman. Faiz dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. dan Dr. Ngadisih, S.T.P., M.Sc., dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai penguji.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-9-image-26-1030x775.webp)

Les’ Aullian A., S.T.P. menyelesaikan penelitian berjudul “Analisis Impedansi Listrik sebagai Indikator Non-Destruktif Status Fisiologis Selada Hidroponik (_Lactuca sativa_ L.) akibat Cekaman Nutrisi dan Air”. Penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa pengukuran impedansi listrik dapat digunakan sebagai indikator nondestruktif untuk mendeteksi status fisiologis tanaman selada hidroponik yang mengalami cekaman nutrisi maupun air. Les’ Aullian dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. dan Prof. Dr. Mohammad Affan Fajar F., M.Agr., dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai penguji.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/915-10-image-27-1030x773.webp)

Arinda Fadea P., S.T.P. menutup rangkaian kelulusan dengan penelitian berjudul “Eksternalisasi Tacit Knowledge dalam Pengambilan Keputusan Operasi Pintu Irigasi Berbasis Kuantifikasi Faktor Eksternal di Daerah Irigasi Sapon, Kulon Progo, Yogyakarta”. Penelitian ini berupaya mendokumentasikan dan mengukur pengetahuan tacit para petugas pintu air agar pengambilan keputusan operasional irigasi dapat lebih terstandardisasi dan terukur. Arinda dibimbing oleh Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. sebagai Dosen Pembimbing I dan Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. sebagai Dosen Pembimbing II, dengan Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai penguji.

Keberhasilan kesebelas mahasiswa dalam menuntaskan penelitian ini tidak lepas dari dukungan berbagai pihak, sehingga Smart Agriculture Research Center menyampaikan terima kasih yang tulus kepada Pusat Unggulan Antar Perguruan Tinggi (PUAPT) UGM atas dukungan fasilitas dan pendanaan riset yang diberikan selama proses penelitian berlangsung. Ucapan terima kasih juga disampaikan kepada SINERGI (Skema Hilirisasi Riset Berbasis Transfer Teknologi Terintegrasi) yang telah memfasilitasi hilirisasi hasil-hasil riset agar dapat memberikan manfaat yang lebih luas bagi dunia pertanian. Dukungan dari kedua program tersebut sangat berperan dalam mendorong kualitas penelitian mahasiswa sekaligus memperkuat ekosistem inovasi teknologi pertanian cerdas di lingkungan Smart Agriculture Research Center. Semoga sinergi ini terus berlanjut dan melahirkan lebih banyak inovasi yang bermanfaat bagi kemajuan sektor pertanian di masa mendatang. Penelitian yang dilakukan ini turut mendukung pencapaian _Sustainable Development Goals_ (SDGs), khususnya SDG 2 (Tanpa Kelaparan) melalui peningkatan produktivitas dan kualitas hasil pertanian, SDG 6 (Air Bersih dan Sanitasi Layak) melalui inovasi sistem irigasi yang lebih efisien, serta SDG 9 (Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur) melalui pengembangan teknologi berbasis machine learning, sensor, dan otomasi. Selain itu, penelitian ini juga sejalan dengan SDG 12 (Konsumsi dan Produksi yang Bertanggung Jawab) melalui optimalisasi penggunaan sumber daya air dan energi, SDG 13 (Penanganan Perubahan Iklim) melalui pengelolaan lahan dan air yang lebih adaptif, serta SDG 17 (Kemitraan untuk Mencapai Tujuan).
